title: TagRouter Configuration
description: Configuration schema for TagRouter, an adaptive LLM routing engine that uses lightweight LLM tag extraction and Bayesian Logistic Bandit with Thompson Sampling for model selection.

tag_schema.description: Defines the semantic tags that the tagger LLM extracts from user queries. Each key is a tag name whose value is a spec defining the tag's type, description, and allowed values.

candidate_models.description: List of model IDs available for routing. The bandit learns per-model success probabilities over the tag feature space.

model_costs.description: Per-model cost values used for cost-aware scoring. score = p_success - cost_weight * (cost / max_cost).

bayesian_bandit.description: Configuration for the Bayesian Logistic Bandit (per-model logistic regression + Thompson Sampling).

prior_var.description: Prior variance for the weight posterior N(0, prior_var * I). Larger values = more initial exploration.

cost_weight.description: Weight for the cost penalty in the Thompson Sampling score. 0 = ignore cost entirely.

database_path.description: Path to the tagged prompts database (JSON array of {model, success, tags, prompt}). Resolved relative to this YAML file's directory.

tagger.description: Configuration for the lightweight LLM tagger that extracts semantic tags from user queries.

model.description: The litellm model ID for the tagger LLM.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens for the tagger's JSON response.

strict_json.description: Whether to use strict JSON Schema response_format. Requires model support.

type.description: The data type of this tag. Currently only 'bool' is fully supported by the Bayesian bandit's _featurize().

required.description: Whether this tag must be present in the LLM's JSON output.

description.description: Human-readable description. Included verbatim in the tagger's system prompt.

values.description: List of allowed values for enum-type tags. Required when type is 'enum'.
